source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Care considered essentially identical to that of a standard peripheral IV line, rather than requiring the added precautions this device needs","B":"Strict sterile technique for any manipulation of the device, given the direct access to the intracranial space and significant infection risk","C":"Allowing essentially any staff member to access the device without any specific training or competency verification required","D":"Carrying fairly few sterile technique requirements despite the significant infection risk this device actually poses"}}
source_row.rationale: ICP monitoring device care requires strict sterile technique for any manipulation, given the direct access to the intracranial space and the significant risk and consequences of infection (such as meningitis or ventriculitis) in this critical location.
source_row.source_detail: Sterile Technique Requirement for ICP Devices
source_row.source_name: AANN — Intracranial Pressure Monitoring Care Guidelines
